Subject: Demonstration of Weave Analyst - the integration of Weave and R - this Wednesday 8-20-14 11 AM EDT

Weave and R Users: 

Georges Grinstein and Shweta Purushe of Umass Lowell’s Institute for Visualization and Perception Research will provide a live demonstration of the latest version of Weave Analyst, a powerful integration of the Weave data visualization platform with the R statistical analysis system (formerly known as Analyst Work Station).   

Weave Analyst can also be configured to integrate Weave with SAS, STATA, or other proprietary statistical packages.  

Weave Analyst has been developed by IVPR in collaboration with three Open Indicators Consortium Members —  the Centers for Disease Control, the Seattle-King County Health Department, and the Providence Plan.

Please join us for this informative, interactive webinar.

Wednesday, August 20, 2014 
11 AM-12 NOON  EDT 

Please register for this free Open Indicators Consortium webinar here: https://www2.gotomeeting.com/register/726292202 

Jim Farnam
Connecticut Data Collaborative and
Open Indicators Consortium
